scope: frontend apiRequest abort and timeout safety

route_change_abort.behavior: abortActiveApiRequests increments route generation and aborts all active controllers
route_change_abort.queued_request_safety: queued requests compare route generation before fetch and fail without hanging

capability_abort_behavior.timeout_behavior: timeout abort terminates bootstrap and surfaces degraded state instead of launching fallback fan-out
capability_abort_behavior.route_change_behavior: route-change abort is retried by CapabilityStateProvider after the route transition

hanging_promise_protection.controller_dispose: timeout listeners and active controllers are removed in finally
hanging_promise_protection.concurrency_release: queued request scheduler releases slots in finally
